About this propertyComfortable Accommodations: Hoi An Delicacy Hotel & Spa in Hoi An offers family rooms with balconies, private bathrooms, and modern amenities. Each room includes air-conditioning, free WiFi, and a work desk.

Wellness and Leisure: Guests can enjoy spa facilities, a wellness centre, and a swimming pool with a view. Additional amenities include a sun terrace, outdoor furniture, and a fitness centre.

Convenient Services: The hotel provides a 24-hour front desk, concierge service, and free on-site private parking. Additional services include a minimarket, room service, and a tour desk.

property.name: La Siesta Hoi An Resort & Spa

translations.name: Veranda Suite with Pool View - Club Wing
translations.description: Period furnishings, antique-style ceiling fan and vintage patterned floor tiles blend Asian and European influences. The focal point is the luxurious king size bed framed with an elegant hoop canopy and soft white linen drapes. Very spacious ensuite bathroom with private sauna, herbal bathtub and separate walk in rainforest shower. Front entrance leads onto a porch with soft seating facing the pool and gardens, the back has access to a shared garden area with fruit trees. Extra bed is not available.

translations.name: Junior Suite with Balcony - Club Wing
translations.description: Located on the upper floor, the junior suite balcony guestrooms feature a large balcony overlooking the pool, gardens and community house. Period furnishings, very dark brown/almost black hard wooden flooring gives elegance and depth, complimenting white walls and cool linens. Large bathroom with a chic vintage-style, free standing bathtub. A pair can be balcony connected, providing ideal vacation for a family or a group of close friends. Extra bed is not available.

translations.name: Premium Suite with Terrace - Club Wing
translations.description: Located on the upper floor, these exclusive terrace suites feature an expansive terrace overlooking the entire property and community house. Large bathroom with a chic vintage-style, free standing bathtub. Each private terrace is furnished with sunbeds and comes with an outdoor Jacuzzi. The terraces can be combined into a larger private space for a group booking. Extra bed is not available.

translations.name: Duplex Suite - Club Wing
translations.description: A two-level design for separated and connected space, ideal for a family or a small group of friends. Lower level with master double bed or twin beds with rainforest shower, toilet and chic vintage-style, free standing bathtub. A wooden staircase leads to the upper rooftop master bedroom with king size bed, ensuite walk in shower and toilet. The lower floor opens onto a spacious balcony overlooking the pool and gardens. Extra bed is not available .

translations.name: Family Room with Balcony - Classic Wing
translations.description: Providing free toiletries and bathrobes, this family room includes a private bathroom with a walk-in shower, a bidet and a hairdryer. The air-conditioned family room provides a flat-screen TV with cable channels, soundproof walls, a tea and coffee maker, a wardrobe as well as an inner courtyard view. The unit offers 2 beds.

translations.name: La Siesta Suite - Classic Wing
translations.description: Spacious suite comes with air conditioning, a balcony and separate seating area with cable flat-screen TV. En suite bathroom is equipped with a walk-in shower, and free toiletries

translations.name: Grand Suite - Classic Wing
translations.description: The suite features a glass-enclosed balcony at the front of the building, offering charming street views. Guests can also enjoy partial views of the river and surrounding fields from the bathroom. A highlight of the suite is the spacious jacuzzi, set within a luxurious bathroom with open views overlooking the fields, local neighborhood, and street scenery.

translations.name: Deluxe Double Room
translations.description: The spacious double room offers air conditioning, soundproof walls, as well as a private bathroom boasting a walk-in shower and a bidet. The unit has 1 bed.

translations.name: Executive Suite, Club Wing
translations.description: Located on the first to fifth floors inclusive, the Executive Suites feature a large 10m2 balcony overlooking the pool and rice fields. Period furnishings, very dark brown/almost black hard wooden flooring gives elegance and depth, complimenting white walls and cool linens. Large bathroom with a chic vintage-style, free standing bathtub. Extra bed is not available.

translations.name: Executive Duplex Suite, Club Wing
translations.description: Top floor with a sub level in the room. The 1st floor with kitchenette, bathroom, lounge and dining areas (provide no cooking tools) opens out onto the 10m2 balcony. Stairs lead to the 2nd floor with master double and en-suite bathroom featuring a rainforest shower, toilet and chic vintage-style, free standing bathtub.

translations.name: Deluxe Twin Room
translations.description: Offering free toiletries and bathrobes, this twin room includes a private bathroom with a walk-in shower, a bidet and a hairdryer. This twin room features air conditioning, soundproof walls, a flat-screen TV with cable channels and a balcony. The unit offers 2 beds.

translations.name: Deluxe Double Room with Balcony
translations.description: The spacious double room provides air conditioning, soundproof walls, as well as a private bathroom featuring a walk-in shower and a bidet. This double room features a tea and coffee maker, a wardrobe, a flat-screen TV with cable channels and a balcony. The unit offers 1 bed.

translations.name: One-Bedroom Suite
translations.description: This suite's special features are the hot tub and the sauna. This spacious suite includes 1 bedroom, a seating area and 1 bathroom with a walk-in shower and a bath. The air-conditioned suite offers a flat-screen TV with cable channels, soundproof walls, a tea and coffee maker, a wardrobe as well as pool views. The unit has 1 bed.
